text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — Orchid has had 3 related escalations this week (2x 503s during peak, 1x inference timeout). Need to confirm RCA, action items, and owner for preventing repeat incidents.

Jon Rivera: saw the spikes on Wednesday morning. usage doubled during the promo window and latency climbed ~2x. I flagged autoscale but it didn't trigger fast enough.

Priya Singh: copying the customer notes: they reported requests queuing for ~14s and some partial responses. They believe our client retry logic retriggered requests.

Alex Chen: looking at logs — there are repeated KV cache-miss storms when sequence length jumped. stack traces show GPU worker pool exhaustion then a 503 downstream from runtime. snippet: ```ERROR runtime: grpc: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing```

Riley (eng-oncall): can confirm autoscaler saw surge but policy has a 30s stabilization delay. by the time new workers came up, upstream queue backpressure had already tripped the worker health probe.

Maya Patel: action proposals: 1) reduce autoscale stabilization to 10s for Orchid's dedicated pool (temp), 2) add a short retry-exponential-backoff client example in onboarding, 3) add a guardrail to reject overly long sequences in the hosted tier and surface recommended quant profiles. Who owns each?

Jon Rivera: I can own #1 with EngOps. I’ll open a change with the reduced stabilization and monitor for 48h.

Priya Singh: I’ll draft the client retry guidance and a short onboarding note that we can send to Orchid tomorrow. will include the recommended header to set max_tokens and sequence_length limits.

Alex Chen: I’ll take #3 — implement a lightweight denylist rule and telemetry alert that counts rejections so we can correlate. ETA: PR by end of week.

Maya Patel: thanks — can we add a postmortem-lite in 3 days with: timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations, and follow-ups? keep it customer-facing (one-pager) and an internal technical appendix.

Riley (eng-oncall): adding: short-term mitigation idea — enable aggressive KV pre-warming for Orchid's top routes to reduce cache miss rate during promotions. I’ll test perf impact.

incident-bot: Incident created: ORCH-2026-0423-503 (link: https://redwood/ops/incidents/ORCH-2026-0423-503) — priority P2. Assigned: Jon Rivera.

Maya Patel: timeline and owners recap: Jon -> autoscale config & incident follow-up (owner). Priya -> customer-facing guidance. Alex -> denylist + telemetry. Riley -> KV pre-warm testing. PRs/notes by EOD Friday, one-pager by Monday. Please add status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Jon Rivera: started the autoscale change, will post config diff here.

Priya Singh: drafting the email now, will share preview in channel.

Alex Chen: created repo branch `orchid-guardrails` and pushed initial rule; ran unit tests. link: https://git.redwood/infra/orchid-guardrails/compare

Riley (eng-oncall): ran KV pre-warm experiment — hit a 30% reduction in tail latency in staging for the promo pattern. sharing metrics snapshot in thread.

Maya Patel: great progress. tagging @support-team to prep a brief customer update once we have the one-pager.

Priya Singh: draft ready, sending to Maya for review.

Jon Rivera: autoscale config diff: ```- stabilizationWindowSeconds: 30
+ stabilizationWindowSeconds: 10``` rolled to canary. monitoring queue depth and CPU.

Maya Patel: leave a note here with any regression signals. If everything looks good after 48h, we can propose the change as a permanent tuning for Orchid.

Alex Chen: telemetry alert added: ORCH_SEQUENCE_REJECTION > 10/min triggers pager to eng-sre.

Riley (eng-oncall): staging looks clean. will run two promo-sim load tests tomorrow morning and post results.

Maya Patel: thanks all. Follow-ups due: status updates in this thread. Will include this in the weekly account health check doc and surface renewal risk if we see another repeat next week.

Jon Rivera: noted. tagging timeline: 48h autoscale watch, EOD Friday PRs, Monday one-pager.

Priya Singh: FYI — customer asked for a chart of errors vs spend. I’ll attach a simple usage chart to the one-pager.

Maya Patel: perfect. closing for now, will reopen thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
